Nexora Technologies is looking for a Business Analyst Intern to work with our product team for six months. You will gather requirements from stakeholders, document user journeys, and analyse product usage data in SQL and Excel.

Stipend: 15,000 per month. Apply through the Nexora careers page; we never ask candidates to pay any fee.
